authority: reviewer 2026-09-18: M1 authorized with three single-block arms. Common base A, donor B, identical future input and RNG stream, exactly one typed state block replaced per arm. Magnitude is not causal authority, so u is kept despite its weak observational evidence. The synaptic arm is incoming-to-PV edges only. No E/PV/SST/VIP split of that arm yet. No conjunction search follows zero flips
declared: 2026-09-18, committed and pushed before the declared procedure runs
question: starting from one identical h_0, which single typed state block, transplanted from the active-fate donor, switches the PV fate

candidate_set.from_M0: only v, u and syn_state differ between h_A(0) and h_B(0); w, H, prev_spikes and b are bitwise identical, and theta_S and aux are empty
candidate_set.excluded: prng_key and step_index (P1: swapping the noise stream does not swap fate); w and H (bitwise identical, so no transplant of them could change anything)

arms.A_CTRL: h_A unmodified. Must reproduce the sealed low-PV fate
arms.B_CTRL: h_B unmodified, run under the same future stream as the A arms. Must reach the active-PV fate
arms.A_v: h_A with the whole v vector (400) replaced by v_B
arms.A_u: h_A with the whole u vector (400) replaced by u_B
arms.A_syn: h_A with the syn_state entries whose postsynaptic cell is PV replaced by those of h_B, all presynaptic classes together

future_stream: every arm starts from PRNGKey(11) at step_index 0 and runs the same schedule, so the future input and noise realization are identical across arms. The donor's own step_index is not carried into an A-based arm: only the named state block moves

frozen.regeneration: both states are regenerated through the sealed build path and must reproduce the sealed v-hashes 83ce0d0c3fc44a71 and 8704423170e6ae32; the pinned npz are the identity reference
frozen.duration: 12 x 5 s chunks (60 s), the fate horizon already qualified by the parent experiment; windows are summarized from chunk 1 as in the parent driver
frozen.fate_definition: the late-window PV rate, the mean over the final three 5 s windows, exactly as in results/v21_pv_predecessor.json P1_fate
frozen.model: V2.1 static column, kernel baseline, HDP detached, native noise, jaxfne 0.4.24, dt 0.1 ms

fate_thresholds: taken from the sealed parent and not redefined after execution: low-PV means the late PV rate is within max(1 Hz, 10%) of the sealed A value 0.707 Hz, active-PV means within max(1 Hz, 10%) of the sealed B value 14.425 Hz. A late rate matching neither is reported as neither, never reinterpreted into one of them

transplant_verification.moved: h'[k] must equal h_B[k] bitwise for the transplanted block
transplant_verification.unmoved: h'[not k] must equal h_A[not k] bitwise for every other leaf of the DynamicState
transplant_verification.syn_arm_scope: the edge indices whose postsynaptic cell is PV, derived from the model edge list; the count and the fraction of syn_state they cover are recorded, and the complement must be bitwise equal to h_A
transplant_verification.on_failure: M1_TRANSPLANT_INVALID, reported before any fate is interpreted

controls.A_CTRL: must reproduce the sealed run A window rates within 0.5 Hz
controls.B_CTRL: must reach the active-PV fate; it runs under the fresh key stream, which is run C of the parent, so its sealed reference is run C at 15.11 Hz
controls.on_failure: M1_CONTROL_FAILED, reported before any transplant fate is interpreted

per_arm.CAUSAL_SUFFICIENT: the A-based transplant reaches the active-PV fate while A_CTRL stays low and B_CTRL stays active
per_arm.NOT_SUFFICIENT: anything else, including a late rate matching neither fate

lineage.SINGLE_BLOCK_SUFFICIENT_PASS: exactly one arm flips; that block is localized as sufficient
lineage.MULTIPLE_BLOCKS_SUFFICIENT_PASS: more than one arm flips; all are reported as independently sufficient and none is ranked
lineage.NO_SINGLE_BLOCK_SUFFICIENT_FAIL: no arm flips; STOP, and no conjunction search follows automatically
lineage.M1_CONTROL_FAILED: a control did not reproduce its sealed fate
lineage.M1_TRANSPLANT_INVALID: a constructed state moved something other than the named block

forbidden: splitting the PV-incoming synaptic arm by presynaptic class: that is a second-stage decomposition, only if this arm flips the fate
transplanting w, H, prev_spikes or b: they are bitwise identical between the two states
combining blocks: a conjunction search requires separate justification
ranking sufficient blocks by the size of their state difference
redefining or weakening the fate thresholds after execution
any lambda, tonic, parameter, topology or kernel change

artifacts.not_committed: per-arm window rates are in the result; no traces are retained

stop: classify each arm and the lineage, write results/v21_pv_m1.json, STOP for review. No mechanism is claimed: a sufficient block is not a mechanism
